{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Convert number to color team name or color.

|s1= [teamId, getColour] call [[BIS_fnc_teamColor]]

|p1= teamId: [[Number]] - in range 1..5

|p2= getColour: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to get [[Color|Color (RGBA)]], [[false]] to get the ''localised'' team name

|r1= [[Color|Color (RGBA)]] or [[String]] - color format [r, g, b, a] or localised team name

|x1= <sqf>_colour = [2, true] call BIS_fnc_teamColor;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_teamName = [2] call BIS_fnc_teamColor;
hint format ["%1 is %2", 2, _teamName];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_colorConfigToRGBA]] [[BIS_fnc_colorRGBAtoHTML]]
}}
